name: Helium Browser [anylinux]
description:
Helium is a lightweight, privacy-focused web browser engineered to deliver a fast and clean browsing experience without superfluous background telemetry or bloat.

Features:
- Minimalist, distraction-free user interface focused entirely on content
- Built-in tracking protection and privacy enhancements
- Fast rendering performance powered by modern web standards
- Low memory footprint compared to mainstream web browsers
- Clean tab management and straightforward bookmark organization

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
